title: feat(approvals): a submitter's agent can recall and resubmit its own approval request over MCP (#32993)
body:
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D16W1qBmDw2VWYAdjQeFBFn)_ Fixes #32993 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:审批单上「撤回」和「重新提交」两个按钮,现在也对 AI 助手开放(通过 MCP 列出、可执行),而且和审批人的四个决定动作一样,每次执行都必须先经用户确认。 - 为什么改:提交人的 AI 助手提交报销单后,用户要改明细,助手得先撤回审批,但 MCP 上没有撤回动作,只能让用户自己去控制台点一下。现在「撤回 → 改单 → 再提交」整条路助手都能走完。 - 风险与回滚:放宽(多开放两个已有动作给 AI)。谁能撤回 / 重提仍只由审批服务判定,和控制台按钮完全一样:提交人可以;待审中的单子管理员可代撤回;其他人一律被拒、单子不动。回滚即删两个 `ai` 块。 - 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts`(`approval_recall`、`approval_resubmit` 的两个 `ai` 块和数组上方说明);`packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-decide-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts`(新增三条端到端钉子)。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/approval-decide-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts`,应见 `Tests 8 passed (8)`。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。 ## What changes The submitter-side branch of ruling A on #32442. PR #32886 exposed the approver's four decisions on `sys_approval_request`; the submitter's own levers on the same object stayed UI-only, so a submitter's agent that had to recall a request (to fix the record) handed the click back to the person. - **`sys-approval-request.object.ts`**: `approval_recall` and `approval_resubmit` declare `ai: { exposed: true, description, requiresConfirmation: true }`, the shape #32886 gave the decisions. Both are already same-origin `type: 'api'` actions targeting `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/{id}/recall` and `/resubmit`, so `run_action` forwards them as the caller and `ApprovalService` stays the only gate: `recall` admits the submitter (and, on a pending request, the #3424 override holder) and refuses anyone else with `approval_recall_not_submitter`; `resubmit` admits the submitter alone and applies only to a `returned` request. No check is added in the MCP door or the action door. - The tool descriptions are their own text (the recall dialog question stays in the top-level `description`, #7278). Recall's tells the agent a recalled request is closed, so sending the record for approval again goes through the app's own submit action; resubmit's tells it resubmit applies only to a request sent back for revision. - **`content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx`**: the default exposure policy gains the submitter's bullet; "the submitter's own levers (remind, recall, resubmit) are not exposed" narrows to remind, request-info and comments. - **Changeset**: `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` patch, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none` (no spec key changes; two existing actions gain an existing key). ## Tests `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.test.ts` (18 tests): - The exposed set is exactly the four decisions plus recall and resubmit. - Recall and resubmit ask for confirmation, name the submitter, carry a ≥40-char description, and target their own same-origin route. - The recall dialog question is never armed as the AI tool description (the old "recall has no `ai.description`" line is replaced by the same not-the-question check `approval_reject` has). `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-decide-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts` (5 → 8, live MCP transport, real security/flows/approvals). The fixture flow gains an ADR-0044 revise window (`revise` → `approval_revise` → `resubmit` back edge); the existing decide pins are unchanged. - `list_actions` for both the approver and the submitter lists the four decisions plus recall and resubmit, each `aiExposed` and `requiresConfirmation`. - The submitter's recall is refused `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` without `confirm: true` (request still pending, nothing recorded), then, confirmed, moves the request to `recalled`, recorded once as `recall` by the submitter. - The approver (not the submitter) is refused recall: `FORBIDDEN`, carrying the `approval_recall_not_submitter` sentence verbatim from `BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES.en`; the request stays pending. - On a request sent back over MCP, the submitter edits the record, then: unconfirmed resubmit is refused, the approver's resubmit is refused `FORBIDDEN`, the request stays `returned` with no round 2; the submitter's confirmed resubmit opens round 2 (one new pending request), recorded as `revise` by the approver and `resubmit` by the submitter.
Ablation: each ai block dropped alone (dogfood aliases plugin-approvals to source, so no rebuild is involved) On committed head `f5587158`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete`, each restored with `blob == HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` empty. - A. `approval_recall`'s `ai` block deleted (anchor x1 → x0): `Tests 3 failed | 5 passed (8)` — the listing pin and both recall pins red. - B. `approval_resubmit`'s `ai` block deleted (anchor x1 → x0): `Tests 2 failed | 6 passed (8)` — the listing pin and the resubmit pin red.
## Acceptance notes - Out of scope, report only: the approver's read door (#32442 read half, blocked on spec #32865) is untouched. The MCP object tools still refuse `sys_*` objects, so an agent finds a request id through the app (as the dogfood file does through the system). - The card's end-to-end story ("recall my claim, fix the lines, resubmit") is: recall over MCP (this PR), edit the record, then the app's own submit action, because a recalled request is closed and `resubmit` applies only to a request an approver sent back. The recall tool description says so, so an agent does not reach for resubmit after a recall. - The #3424 override holder's agent can now recall a pending request it did not submit, exactly as the console's Recall button already lets that administrator do; this is the existing service admission, not a new reach. - Remind stays unexposed (not named by the card). ## Verification Head `f5587158` (origin/main `12b14462` merged before the PR opened; main had not moved). Every exit captured before any pipe.
Package tests and typecheck - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals test`: `Test Files 118 passed (118)`, `Tests 1624 passed (1624)`. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` + scripts + `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0. - `sys-approval-request.object.test.ts`: `Tests 18 passed (18)`; `approval-decide-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts`: `Tests 8 passed (8)`. - Prerequisite: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build` under the verify lock, exit 0.
Derived gates (dispatch-gates.mjs --commands, 96) and lint - 92 of 96 exit 0 on the first pass. - `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`: exit 3 on the shallow clone (pinned fixture commit unreachable); after fetching `621a4876`, exit 0 (48 cases). - `check:skill-examples`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3 / 1) — they read every package's `dist/`, and this tree had built only the dogfood closure. NOT MEASURED at PR open; a whole-tree `turbo run build` is running, and the re-run verdicts and the `--ran` reconciliation go into the os-dev report on #32993. None of them reads a file this diff touches beyond the built output. - `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0.
